plan.stop_scope: Remaining arms of the failed case
plan.scope: One sample per case/arm; observed ratios and material/state differences, no statistical certification.

runtime_input_proof.scope: Old bytes unchanged. Only selected derived .16 runtime caches added; executables are reused, not rebuilt.

plan.guard_gate: All-scene hard checks and typed/energy pool validation; frozen cloth material bounds. Mixed differences remain pending, not a cloth-screen prerequisite.
plan.round_gate: Analyze completed round before next launch; hard checks, cloth bounds and initial-state matching required. No candidate-based tolerance expansion.
plan.after_screen: No automatic long run. Cost-package evidence and independent quality review still required.

active_manifest.scope: Post-build source/executable/commands identity; producer must perform clean build. This tool does not compile or certify compiler correctness.

runtime_input_supplement.scope: Same executable/object/link identity with explicitly sealed additional runtime sorting caches.

compiler_identity.scope: Compiler binary identity from CMakeCache. System shared libraries are not exhaustively frozen.
